question: In which of the following countries did Mahendra Gurjar set a world record in para javelin in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahendra Gurjar**, a prominent Indian para-athlete, made headlines in **2025** by setting a new **World Record** in the **para javelin throw**.
 
• The record-shattering performance took place at the **World Para Athletics Grand Prix** held in **Nottwil, Switzerland**.
 
• Gurjar competed in the **F-44 category**, which is specifically for athletes with a limb deficiency or impaired muscle power, often affecting one or both legs but allowing them to throw from a standing position.
 
• He achieved a massive distance of **65.04 metres**, which stands as the new benchmark in the **F-44 classification**, surpassing the previous world record.
 
• This victory in **Switzerland** is considered a major milestone for **Indian Para-Athletics**, further establishing India's dominance
